استمجدت (form X)
# اِسْتَمْجَدْتُ (istamjadtu) /is.tam.d͡ʒad.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَمْجَدَ (istamjada)
# اِسْتَمْجَدْتَ (istamjadta) /is.tam.d͡ʒad.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَمْجَدَ (istamjada)
# اِسْتَمْجَدْتِ (istamjadti) /is.tam.d͡ʒad.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَمْجَدَ (istamjada)
# اِسْتَمْجَدَتْ (istamjadat)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
